display.purpose: Hero headlines only, one per page, centered. Outfit 800.

headline.purpose: Section titles, always with the 60x4px orange bar beneath.

body.purpose: Prose in DM Sans; tabular numerals globally.

label.purpose: JetBrains Mono for data vintage, badges and chart notes.

shadows.name: md
shadows.purpose: Metric cards, use-case cards, lead form, buttons at rest.

shadows.name: lg
shadows.purpose: Card hover, fixed header after scroll, mobile nav drop.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for layout and color state transitions.

motion.name: fade-up
motion.purpose: Hero entrance, staggered by .animate-delay-1..5 (0.1s steps). Scroll reveals travel translateY(30px) with opacity 0 to 1.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Client proof wall. Pauses on hover and when offscreen; plays once under prefers-reduced-motion. Documented detector exception.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Orange gradient CTA. The only element allowed the colored action shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--secondary-color) 0%, #cc6a00 100%); color: #ffffff; padding: 1rem 2.5rem; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid transparent; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07); transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-color); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White-bordered ghost CTA for navy surfaces only.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #ffffff; padding: 1rem 2.5rem; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ffffff; color: var(--primary-color); transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Lead Interest Option
components.description: Radio row inside the lead form. The form's first step and its only selected state.
components.css: .ds-lead-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.85rem; padding: 0.9rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(75, 85, 99, 0.3); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; background: #ffffff; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-lead-option input { width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--secondary-color); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-lead-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.15rem; } .ds-lead-text strong { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-dark); font-size: 1rem; } .ds-lead-text small { color: var(--text-medium); font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-lead-option:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--secondary-color); background: rgba(238, 121, 0, 0.1); } .ds-lead-option:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--secondary-color); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: Text field in the lead form. Orange border plus soft ring on focus, no outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-field label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--text-dark); } .ds-field input, .ds-field textarea { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text-dark); background: var(--bg-light); border: 1px solid rgba(75, 85, 99, 0.3); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-field input:focus-visible, .ds-field textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--secondary-color); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(238, 121, 0, 0.2); }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Data metric tile from /base-de-datos. Navy figure, navy gradient icon, neutral lift on hover.
components.html:
Propiedades en la base23.222

Casas, departamentos, terrenos, locales, oficinas y más.
components.css: .ds-metric { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; padding: 2.5rem; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07); text-align: center; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.4s ease; font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-metric:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); } .ds-metric-icon { width: 56px; height: 56px; margin: 0 auto 1.25rem; border-radius: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #004080 0%, #002857 100%); } .ds-metric-label { display: block; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: var(--text-light); margin-bottom: 0.25rem; } .ds-metric-value { display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--primary-color); line-height: 1.2; } .ds-metric-desc { color: var(--text-medium); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.6; margin-top: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Use-Case Card
components.description: Whole-card link to an external report; orange 'Acceder' pinned to the bottom.
components.html:
Inteligencia inmobiliaria Santa Cruz

Panel de indicadores del mercado inmobiliario de Santa Cruz — ciclo, oferta, ventas, financiamiento y precios.

Acceder →
components.css: .ds-use-case { display: flex; flex-direction: column; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; padding: 2.5rem; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-body); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.4s ease; } .ds-use-case:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); } .ds-use-case h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-dark); margin: 0 0 0.75rem; } .ds-use-case p { color: var(--text-medium); line-height: 1.7; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; flex: 1; } .ds-use-case span { color: #a14c00; font-weight: 500; margin-top: auto; } .ds-use-case:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-color); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Data Toggle Group
components.description: Pill container of filter buttons on /base-de-datos; active state is a navy fill.
components.css: .ds-toggle-group { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.35rem; background: #ffffff; padding: 0.35rem; border: 1px solid rgba(75, 85, 99, 0.25); border-radius: 10px; font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-toggle { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.45rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--text-medium); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 0.25s ease; } .ds-toggle:hover { color: var(--primary-color); background: rgba(0, 40, 87, 0.1); } .ds-toggle.is-active { background: var(--primary-color); color: #ffffff; } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-color); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The system reads as an institutional intelligence desk: a deep navy world interrupted by white proof sections, with orange reserved for the signal — a number, a link, a call to action. It is dense with evidence (counts, maps, charts, censuses) and light on decoration. Nothing is illustrated that could be measured. It ships in two themes — light and dark — driven entirely by prefers-color-scheme, with no in-page toggle. Both themes carry the same navy/orange identity; dark mode reskins surfaces and inverts ink rather than inventing a second palette.
keyCharacteristics: Data-forward: statistics are typographic elements, not captions
Two-theme system: light default, dark automatic, same identity in both
Documentary density: divided lists, tables of numbers, real charts, a real map
Restraint in motion: one entrance animation, one hover lift, nothing ambient

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange is intelligence and action, never decoration. A number worth reading, a link worth following, a button worth pressing — nothing else.

rules.name: The Two-Theme Rule
rules.body: Every new surface must be checked in both themes. A component that only defines light values is unfinished, and any color hardcoded in JS (Chart.js datasets) must exist in both.

rules.name: The Contrast Ink Rule
rules.body: Orange text on a light surface uses Signal Ink, not the base Signal.

rules.name: The One Bar Rule
rules.body: Section titles get the orange underline exactly once, from the shared .section-title::after rule: 60x4px, gradient, 2px radius, 1rem auto 0. Never redraw it locally.

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono only marks machine output — badges, vintages, counts, chart annotations. Never body copy, never headlines.

rules.name: The No-Floating-Cards Rule
rules.body: Content lives inside container bands. If a section needs separation, change the band color or add a hairline divider before adding a shadow.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one decorative accent in the system: the 60x4px orange bar under section titles. No top-edge bars, side tabs, gradient stripes or icon chips added to cards to make them feel designed.

rules.name: The Soft-Lift Rule
rules.body: A card rests on level 1-2 and rises one level on hover, moving -4px. No ambient glow, no shadow larger than --shadow-lg, no colored shadow.

dos: Do keep the two-theme contract: check every surface in light and dark before calling it done.
Do let numbers carry the section — orange figures, mono labels, real counts from data/propiedades.json.
Do alternate Paper and Surface bands, and use one full-bleed navy band per page for emphasis.
Do use --gradient-secondary for every orange fill and keep orange text at Signal Ink or lighter stops.
Do reuse .section-title, .btn, .use-case-card and the .db-* patterns before inventing a parallel one.
Do keep one entrance animation (fadeInUp) and one hover lift language across components.
Do run the mechanical detector over touched pages before shipping UI: it should come back with zero findings.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: the reduction block disables reveals, counters and leaves the marquee stopped after one pass.
donts: Don't introduce a light/dark toggle UI; the theme follows the OS preference only.
Don't hardcode chart or map colors that only work on a light background.
Don't use house icons, warm family photography, or 'find your dream home' clichés.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text), cream/beige backgrounds, or generic SaaS card grids.
Don't put an all-caps tracked eyebrow above every section heading — the mono badge is for data screens only.
Don't use a border radius above 16px on cards, or combine a 1px border with a 16px+ blur shadow on the same element.
Don't place the white-bordered secondary button on a light surface.
Don't revive the Jul-IA chat mockup or .btn-julia styles: that landing no longer exists.
Don't add a colored glow shadow (orange under a button, navy under a card): elevation is neutral black.
Don't nest a card inside a card; flatten the map frame, the toggle group and the fallback overlay into the band.
Don't replace the client marquee with a static grid or remove its duplicated track; the movement is the spec.
